```artifact
Feature: Services Offered in and around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario: Services offered within a radius of 25 sqkm
    Given the patient's address is within a radius of 25 sqkm from Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the patient to register for an appointment

  Scenario: Services offered for patients residing in the zone
    Given the patient's address is within the zone
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the patient to register for an appointment

  Scenario: Authorized Chemist per Pincode
    Given there is an authorized chemist for the patient's Pincode
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the authorized chemist

  Scenario: Prescription routing based on Pincode
    Given the patient's Pincode matches the chemist's Pincode
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the chemist

  Scenario: Chemist delivers medicines through Offline delivery
    Given the chemist has received the prescription
    When the chemist delivers the medicines to the patient
    Then the system should mark the prescription as completed

  Scenario: Chemist collects payments from Patients
    Given the patient has received the medicines
    When the patient pays the chemist
    Then the system should update the payment status

  Scenario: No systemic matching done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist
    Given the system does not perform any matching to determine the chemist's efficiency
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the authorized chemist

  Scenario: Authorized Laboratory per Pincode or Zone
    Given there is an authorized laboratory for the patient's Pincode or Zone
    When the patient requests a laboratory test
    Then the system should route the request to the authorized laboratory

  Scenario Outline: Services offered within a radius of 25 sqkm - Examples
    Given the patient's address is within a radius of <radius> sqkm from Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should <result> allow the patient to register for an appointment

    Examples:
      | radius | result        |
      | 24.9   | allow         |
      | 25     | allow         |
      | 25.1   | do not allow  |
      | 0      | do not allow  |
      | 26     | do not allow  |

  Scenario Outline: Prescription routing based on Pincode - Examples
    Given the patient's Pincode is <pincode> and the chemist's Pincode is <chemist_pincode>
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should <result> route the prescription to the chemist

    Examples:
      | pincode | chemist_pincode | result        |
      | 12345   | 12345          | route         |
      | 12345   | 67890          | do not route  |
      | 67890   | 12345          | do not route  |
      | 12345   | 12345          | route         |

  Scenario Outline: Chemist 24/7 operation - Examples
    Given the current time is <time>
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should <result> allow the chemist to deliver the medicines

    Examples:
      | time          | result        |
      | 08:00:00      | allow         |
      | 17:00:00      | allow         |
      | 23:00:00      | allow         |
      | 00:00:00      | allow         |
      | 07:00:00      | do not allow  |
```
